intro: The events pack: events with their sessions, ticket types and seating, tickets sold at the desk, the door or online, entry at the gate by scanning, sponsors and venues. Switch it on in Organisation › Business › Industry packs.
start: Turn the events pack on in Organisation › Business › Industry packs.
Add the places you hold events at on Venues.
Make an event on Events, with its ticket types.
Sell tickets, then check people in at the gate on Check-in.

articles.title: Add a venue
articles.summary: Record a place where you hold events, so you can pick it when you plan one.
articles.after: The venue shows in the list with where it is and how many it holds.
tips: Choose Change… in a venue's Actions to correct it, or Retire when you no longer use it.

articles.title: Check tickets at the gate
articles.summary: Scan each ticket as people arrive and see how many are in.

steps.rest: The gate, or one of the event's sessions. This shows only when the event has sessions.

steps.lead: Click Scan the code, or type the ticket number
steps.rest: then scan the code, or type the number, for example T-XXXXXXXXXX.
the answer shows as Welcome or Not let in, with the reason.

articles.after: The scan shows under Recent scans, and the count of people in goes up.
tips: Above the scan box you see how many are in, how many are not yet in, and how many duplicates were refused.
A ticket scanned twice is refused the second time.
Press Show only refusals to see who was turned away.

articles.title: Find a ticket order and refund it
articles.summary: Look up who bought tickets, send the tickets again, or refund the order.
